```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
con = dbConnect(SQLite(), "me315.sqlite")
```

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT * FROM PRESERVE
ORDER BY ACRES
```

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT PNAME, FEE FROM PRESERVE
WHERE STATE = 'MT'
ORDER BY PNAME DESC
```

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT FEE, ACRES FROM PRESERVE
ORDER BY FEE, ACRES
```

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT PNAME FROM PRESERVE
WHERE STATE = 'AZ'
ORDER BY PNO
```

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT STATE, FEE, PNO FROM PRESERVE
WHERE ACRES > 100
ORDER BY STATE DESC, FEE DESC, PNO 
```

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT * FROM PRESERVE
WHERE STATE >= 'M'
```

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT * FROM PRESERVE
WHERE PNAME < 'TATKON'
```

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT *FROM EMPLOYEE
ORDER BY ENAME
```

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT ENAME, SALARY FROM EMPLOYEE
WHERE SALARY > 2000
ORDER BY SALARY DESC
```

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT DNO, ENO, ENAME FROM EMPLOYEE
ORDER BY DNO DESC, ENO
```
